描述_EN: this figure represents a woman looking into a mirror. the grave goods would allow the deceased to continue a similar life style in the underworld. in the tang dynasty (618-907) grave goods included replicas of men and women engaged in work or leisurely recreations, made from pottery but in reduced size.
描述_ZN: 此图代表一个女人在照镜子。 年，这些墓葬用品可以让死者在冥界继续保持类似的生活方式。 在唐代（618-907）的墓葬物品中包括从事工作或休闲娱乐的男人和女人的复制品，由陶器制成但尺寸缩小。
